scope: Independent server security and real HTTP review only
findings: All four new routes authenticate with identity.me; requireShift verifies ownership.
Server reads avatar from identity; client deadline, mode, duration and equipment do not select authoritative state.
All keys which resume an active round bind to it, bounded at64; replay after completion cannot create a new clock.
Accepted answer is stored exactly once; replay retains current session and cannot increase progress.
Late answer persists completion at original deadline before returning accepted=false; audit retains only accepted answers.
Ordinary shift task, reference, reveal, answer and result paths reject blitz IDs.
Immutable11-field snapshot, zero charges and absent rewards are enforced on write and restored-data validation.
Current bank is draft; no source-backed task definitions, answers, explanations or method profiles changed.
limits: Browser layout, actual GPU performance and authentication through a graphical browser are not covered by this server review.
